brief:
Austria's expansive anti-terror legislation is being weaponized against journalism covering Palestine, Middle East Eye reported, citing the case of Palestinian journalist Mustafa Ayyash. The country's authorities have increasingly applied counter-terrorism statutes in ways that conflate reporting with political advocacy, eroding protections for press freedom.

The Ayyash case exemplifies how security laws intended to target violent extremism now ensnare journalists engaged in standard newsgathering and analysis. Austria's approach signals a broader trend of governments using terror legislation as a mechanism to restrict coverage of contentious geopolitical conflicts.

title: Austria's anti-terror laws criminalize Palestine journalism, columnist warns
